name: Dimple Lock Picking
description: Dimple locks use a key with cuts on its face rather than its edge, requiring a different pick geometry. They are common in higher-security residential and commercial applications in Europe and increasingly in North America. Dedicated dimple picks navigate the lock's unique geometry, and tension is applied in a different plane than standard pin tumbler picking. Encountering a dimple lock on target requires specific tooling — standard picks will not engage the mechanism.

blue.det: Time at door without key; specialized pick visible in keyway; scratching on face of cylinder.
blue.cm: High-security dimple cylinders with security pins; limited availability of quality dimple picks reduces casual attack risk; door alarms.
